draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 234th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 25th of 25 at RB. He went 239th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,115 rushing yards in 2024, 16th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.
